title: Program-label tags
statement: For $k,L\in\mathbb N$, define a finite set of program-label tags: eight unindexed tags $rN,nInc,nOne,nOut0,rT,tInc,rZ,zInc$; tags $lay(t_0)$ indexed by a bit; tags $tp(\theta,pc)$ with a template $\theta$ and a program counter $pc<L+1$; tags $pI(\theta)$ and $pQ(\theta)$ for each template; tags $cp(s,ph)$ with a copy-state tag $s$ and $ph<7$; tags $dA(\tau,t_0)$ and $dB(\tau,t_0)$ with $\tau<k$ and a bit; tags $hd(h)$ and $dl(h)$ with a head-state tag $h$; tags $zb(t_0),ub(t_0),ub2(t_0),iPA(t_0),iPB(t_0),eT(t_0),eT2(t_0)$ indexed by a bit; tags $cl(s,ph)$ with a clause-state tag $s$ and $ph<2$; and a single tag $stop$.
